# HexPiece 3.5.7

Fishman Karate removed, Iron Fist emptied for its remake. Not tested in game yet: the build and the tests pass.

- **Fishman Karate is gone from the game**: no longer on the start menu, all its moves, animations and effects removed (Water
  Bullet, Water Prison, Brick Fist, Spear Wave, Vagabond Drill, Five-Thousand Brick Fist). Pirate NPCs no longer use it.
- A player who had picked Fishman Karate gets the start menu again on their next login to choose a new style.
- **Iron Fist has no abilities** while it is being made anew: no M1 string, no specials, and no Galaxy Fist. It can still be
  picked; until the new moves land, an Iron Fist player punches with the game's own punch (combat mode and R stay the game's).
  Marine and pirate NPCs no longer use Iron Fist.
- Saves keep working: every other style keeps its saved number, so Black Leg, Six Powers and Swordsman players and NPCs are
  unchanged. Update both the server and every client together (the network version changed).
